P086.title: A spectral element-based dynamic model for train-track-tunnel-soil interaction
P086.authors: L Pan, L Xu, B Yan, M Chen
P086.label: Pan等（2025）

complete_examples.text: Leveraging the low-frequency nature of infrastructure vibration, this study introduces Gaussian precise integration method, com bined with multi-step hybrid solution, enables accurate resolution of infrastructure vibration with arbitrary integration step.

The following of this paper can be outlined as follows: • In Section “Framework for TTTS coupled system”, the components of the TTTS system and its simulation methodology are briefly described; • In Section “Model description for TTTS system”, the comprehensive formulation of the dynamic matrices for each system component, based on the spectral element method, is specifically presented, as the focus of the research work in this paper; • In Section “Solution method for TTTS coupled dynamic system”, the solution method for the TTTS coupled dynamical system is pre sented, where a Gaussian precise integration method is introduced to improve the computational accuracy of the large-step integrals, based on the Ref. [50].
